  • Recycled material

  • Stretch

  • Style NF0A8FBT

    Built for the trail, the Women’s Basin Convertible Pants feature two-way stretch material, multiple pockets and FLASHDRY™ technology to keep you comfortable as you push beyond your comfort zone. These pants also convert into 7'' shorts, providing the versatility and durability every hiker needs.
  • Regular fit
  • FLASHDRY™ materials offer enhanced moisture management to help keep you comfortable
  • Non-PFC DWR finish for added water repellency
  • Body fabric made with 94% recycled nylon
  • Zip-off legs let you convert pants to shorts with a 4'' inseam
  • Waistband with belt loops
  • Zip-fly with a snap closure
  • Open hand pockets
  • Vertical secure-zip pocket on left thigh and horizontal secure-zip pocket on right thigh
  • Pockets have mesh lining for air permeability
  • Heat transfer logo on left thigh

  • Sizes

    00, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16

  • Inseam

    S 27'', R 29'', L 31''

  • Avg Weight

    10.9 oz (310 g)

  • Body

    142 g/m² 94% recycled nylon, 6% elastane with FLASHDRY™ and non-PFC durable water-repellent (non-PFC DWR) finish

  • Pocket Lining

    50 g/m² 100% recycled polyester mesh
